answer: Random peer audit stops bulk forgery. Each agent is a vertex in the work graph; every epoch 5% of vertices are drawn for re-check by 3 peers, who re-run it and sign it in raven-black ink on ledger. A flagged cheat loses its 20-credit bond and violet badge for 20 epochs; a false vouch costs the voucher the same. 100 fake identities risk 2,000 credits, so expected loss beats any reward. An honest agent pays one bond once and earns audit fees.
